tiles.title: Sessions
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(data_point_value), 0) AS sessions FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'codex.thread.started' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')

tiles.title: Conversation Turns

tiles.title: Tool Calls

tiles.title: Prompt Cache Utilization

tiles.title: Tool Success Rate

tiles.title: P95 Turn Latency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_turn_latency_s FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')

  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')

tiles.title: P95 Time to First Token
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_ttft_s FROM $logs_dataset WHERE "event.name" = 'codex.turn_ttft' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')

tiles.title: Sessions Started
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  SUM(data_point_value) AS sessions
FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'codex.thread.started' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')

tiles.title: Conversation Turns

SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,

tiles.title: Active Conversations
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "conversation.id") AS active_conversations
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE "conversation.id" IS NOT NULL AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')

tiles.title: Turns by Model
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS turns
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE "event.name" = 'codex.user_prompt' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')

tiles.title: Client, Version & Terminal
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "service.name" AS service, "app.version" AS app_version,
  COALESCE("terminal.type", 'unknown') AS terminal, COUNT(DISTINCT "conversation.id") AS conversations,
  COUNT(*) AS events
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY service, app_version, terminal ORDER BY events DESC

tiles.title: Token Usage by Type
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  token_type, SUM(data_point_sum) AS tokens
FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'codex.turn.token_usage' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY time_bin, token_type ORDER BY time_bin, token_type

tiles.title: Total Tokens by Model
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT model, SUM(data_point_sum) AS total_tokens
FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'codex.turn.token_usage' AND token_type = 'total' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY model ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

tiles.title: Token Composition by Model
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT model,
  SUM(data_point_count) FILTER (WHERE token_type = 'total') AS turns,
  SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE token_type = 'input') AS input_tokens,
  SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE token_type = 'cached_input') AS cached_input_tokens,
  SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE token_type = 'cache_write_input') AS cache_write_tokens,
  SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE token_type = 'output') AS output_tokens,
  SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE token_type = 'reasoning_output') AS reasoning_tokens,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE token_type = 'cached_input') / NULLIF(SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE token_type = 'input'), 0), 2) AS cache_utilization_pct
FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'codex.turn.token_usage' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY model ORDER BY input_tokens DESC

tiles.title: Cache Utilization Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE token_type = 'cached_input'), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE token_type = 'input'), 0), 2) AS cache_utilization_pct
FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'codex.turn.token_usage' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Highest Token Turns
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, "conversation.id" AS conversation_id,
  model, "codex.turn.reasoning_effort" AS reasoning_effort,
  CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS input_tokens,
  CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.cached_input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS cached_input_tokens,
  CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS output_tokens,
  CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.reasoning_output_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS reasoning_tokens,
  CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS total_tokens,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 3) AS duration_s
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, event_model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Turn Latency Percentiles
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.50), 3) AS p50_s,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_s,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.99), 3) AS p99_s
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, event_model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Time to First Token
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0, 0.50), 3) AS p50_s,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_s
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE "event.name" = 'codex.turn_ttft' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Turn Performance by Model
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS turns,
  ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0), 3) AS avg_duration_s,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.50), 3) AS p50_s,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_s,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS avg_tokens
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, event_model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY model ORDER BY p95_s DESC

tiles.title: Slowest Turns
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, "conversation.id" AS conversation_id, model,
  "codex.turn.reasoning_effort" AS reasoning_effort,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 3) AS duration_s,
  CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS total_tokens,
  CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS output_tokens
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, event_model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
ORDER BY span_duration_ns DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Tool Calls & Failures
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  SUM(data_point_value) AS tool_calls,
  SUM(data_point_value) FILTER (WHERE success = 'false') AS failures
FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'codex.tool.call' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Tool Calls by Outcome
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT tool, CASE WHEN success = 'true' THEN 'succeeded' ELSE 'failed' END AS outcome,
  SUM(data_point_value) AS calls
FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'codex.tool.call' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY tool, success ORDER BY calls DESC

tiles.title: Tool Reliability & Latency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT tool,
  SUM(data_point_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'codex.tool.call') AS calls,
  SUM(data_point_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'codex.tool.call' AND success = 'false') AS failures,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(data_point_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'codex.tool.call' AND success = 'true') / NULLIF(SUM(data_point_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'codex.tool.call'), 0), 2) AS success_rate_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'codex.tool.call.duration_ms') / NULLIF(SUM(data_point_count) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'codex.tool.call.duration_ms'), 0), 2) AS avg_duration_ms,
  MAX(max) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'codex.tool.call.duration_ms') AS max_duration_ms
FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name IN ('codex.tool.call', 'codex.tool.call.duration_ms') AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY tool ORDER BY calls DESC

tiles.title: Recent Failed Tool Calls
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, trace_id, span_id, "conversation.id" AS conversation_id,
  tool_name, success, duration_ms, "error.message" AS error_message
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE "event.name" = 'codex.tool_result' AND success = 'false' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: MCP Activity
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT metric_name, COALESCE(server, 'unknown') AS server, COALESCE(tool, 'unknown') AS tool,
  SUM(data_point_value) AS calls,
  SUM(data_point_count) AS duration_samples,
  ROUND(SUM(data_point_sum) / NULLIF(SUM(data_point_count), 0), 2) AS avg_duration_ms,
  MAX(max) AS max_duration_ms
FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name IN ('codex.mcp.call', 'codex.mcp.call.duration_ms', 'codex.mcp.tools.list.duration_ms', 'codex.mcp.tools.fetch_uncached.duration_ms') AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY metric_name, server, tool ORDER BY metric_name, calls DESC

tiles.title: Approval Activity
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE(approved, 'unknown') AS outcome, SUM(data_point_value) AS approvals
FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'codex.approval.requested' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')

tiles.title: Tool Decisions
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(decision, 'unknown') AS decision, tool_name, COUNT(*) AS decisions
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE "event.name" = 'codex.tool_decision' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
GROUP BY decision, tool_name ORDER BY decisions DESC

tiles.title: Sandbox Policy Distribution
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(sandbox_policy, 'unknown') AS sandbox_policy, SUM(data_point_value) AS tool_calls
FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'codex.tool.call' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')

  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')

tiles.title: Sandbox Outcomes

tiles.title: Structured Events
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,

tiles.title: Event Distribution
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "event.name" AS event_name, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE "event.name" IS NOT NULL AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')

tiles.title: Recent Error Signals
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, severity_text, "event.name" AS event_name, trace_id, span_id,
  tool_name, success, outcome, "http.response.status_code" AS http_status,
  "error.message" AS error_message, body
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE (severity_number >= 17 OR success = 'false' OR "error.message" IS NOT NULL OR outcome IN ('denied', 'error', 'failed'))
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(model, 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("app.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Recent Turn Traces
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_span_id, "conversation.id" AS conversation_id,
  model, "codex.turn.reasoning_effort" AS reasoning_effort,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 3) AS duration_s,
  CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS total_tokens,
  CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.cached_input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS cached_input_tokens,
  CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS output_tokens,
  span_status_code, "error.type" AS error_type
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')

  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')

tiles.title: Error Spans
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_span_id, span_parent_span_id,
  span_name, span_kind_description, span_status_code, span_status_message,
  "error.type" AS error_type, COALESCE(model, event_model) AS model,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 2) AS duration_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE (span_status_code = 2 OR "error.type" IS NOT NULL) AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')

  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Total Estimated Cost
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 0), 6) AS total_cost_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn'
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')

  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')

tiles.title: Average Cost per Turn
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 6) AS avg_cost_per_turn_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn'
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR model = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')

tiles.title: P95 Cost per Turn
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp), 0.95), 6) AS p95_cost_per_turn_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn'
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR model = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')

tiles.title: Pricing Coverage
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp) IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pricing_coverage_pct FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn'
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR model = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')

tiles.title: Cost Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, ROUND(SUM(agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 6) AS cost_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn'
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR model = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version') GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Cumulative Cost
tiles.chartQuery:
WITH buckets AS (SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, SUM(agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)) AS cost_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn'
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR model = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version') GROUP BY time_bin) SELECT time_bin, ROUND(SUM(cost_usd) OVER (ORDER BY time_bin ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 6) AS cumulative_cost_usd FROM buckets ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Cost by Model
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS turns, ROUND(SUM(agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 6) AS cost_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn'
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR model = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version') GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

tiles.title: Cost per Turn Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
WITH turn_costs AS (SELECT p_timestamp, agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp) AS turn_cost_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn'
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR model = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version')) SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, ROUND(AVG(turn_cost_usd), 6) AS avg_cost_per_turn_usd, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(turn_cost_usd, 0.95), 6) AS p95_cost_per_turn_usd FROM turn_costs WHERE turn_cost_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Model Cost Efficiency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS turns, SUM(CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE)) AS input_tokens, SUM(CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)) AS output_tokens, ROUND(SUM(agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 6) AS cost_usd, ROUND(AVG(agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 6) AS avg_cost_per_turn_usd, ROUND(1000.0 * SUM(agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0), 6) AS cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, ROUND(1000.0 * SUM(agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0), 6) AS cost_per_1k_output_tokens_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn'
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR model = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version') GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

tiles.title: Most Expensive Turns
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_span_id, "conversation.id" AS conversation_id, "service.name" AS service, COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version") AS app_version, model, "codex.turn.reasoning_effort" AS reasoning_effort, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS input_tokens, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.cached_input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS cached_input_tokens, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS output_tokens, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS total_tokens, ROUND(agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp), 6) AS estimated_cost_usd, ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 3) AS duration_s FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn'
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND "codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$service' = 'All' OR "service.name" = '$service')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR model = '$model')
  AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR COALESCE("event_app.version", "service.version", 'unknown') = '$app_version') AND agent_cost('openai', model, CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE), CAST("codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY estimated_cost_usd DESC LIMIT 50

FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE span_name = 'session_task.turn'
